scope: Original environment/design color roles only; preserve scientific meaning and real material/skin/nature colors.
color_space: sRGB display-reference hex values; not unconverted scene-linear shader values
adoption: Select an applicable direction and adapt to the actual subject; not a fixed series LUT, subject-category router or requirement to render all variants. Bright appearance is a lighting outcome, not a light-background requirement; background value is independent.

looks.name: Bright precision workstation
looks.use_when: Evidence-based equipment, manufacturing operations, precision mechanisms or assembly environments. Applicable to either realism or Blender without automatically switching tools.

palette.role: Bright warm-gray wall/adjacent support surface; preserve visible seams and volume
Quiet low-saturation gray-green environment surface, locally distinct from white housings/metal
Purposeful medium-value structural surface or equipment surroundings; may accompany dark staging, with lighting/reflections revealing structure and contact
Use only when the real object already has this paint color or in a necessary self-designed emphasis layer; do not compete with scientific functional colors

looks.palette_note: These are sRGB visual starting points for self-produced environments/design layers, not mandatory scientific-object colors, Blender scene-linear values or a fixed whole-film grade.

optional_accent.role: Small clean cobalt accent on a legitimately designed environment/graphic area; avoid competing with the observation target or existing semantic colors.

looks.name: Natural daylight colors
looks.use_when: The topic actually involves daytime nature/everyday scenes whose environment and phenomena permit bright natural light. Handle nighttime, deep-sea, luminous or spectral phenomena under their own observation conditions.

palette.role: Evidence-based sky/distant bright air or a self-produced neutral observation background
Evidence-based warm neutral reference for soil/wood/support surfaces
Reference color for actual low-saturation environmental vegetation; actual species/lighting take precedence
Reference for actual leaf/terrain shadows; preserve the topic's required structure and environmental depth without forcing natural shadows brighter

looks.palette_note: An optional daylight/support-surface color relationship. Preserve actual ecology, skin, species, liquids and scientific false color according to evidence rather than forcing every nature topic into this palette.

optional_accent.role: Small warm sunlit/carrier accent only when the actual scene supports it; retain natural subject colors.

looks.name: Clear material observation bench
looks.use_when: Evidence-based experiments/materials/transparent-fluid observation, ceramics or local cutaways. Suitable for mechanism close-ups and comparisons with physical supports, without becoming the whole film's only empty background.

palette.role: Pale violet-gray far-side surface distinct from blue-gray, used for actual spatial turns
Warm pale neutral support surface revealing transparent edges and color
Mid-value structure/reflection-control surface; combine with light or dark backgrounds according to actual lighting without restricting staging value

looks.palette_note: Pale blue-violet organizes only self-produced backgrounds/supports. Lighting should preserve material colors as far as possible; prevent colored-background reflections from altering the color meaning of compared samples.

optional_accent.role: Restrained cooler design accent outside color-critical sample regions; do not tint the specimen or its illumination.

looks.name: Dark staging with sculpted subject light
looks.use_when: Dark workstations, material presentations or local mechanisms needing a quiet background and controlled reflections. A dark background does not require scientifically dark surroundings or change the established production tool.

palette.role: Optional deep graphite background/far-side surface, preserving applicable spatial depth without raising blacks to gray
Optional dark-midtone support/adjacent surface, arranged for actual support and composition
Display reference for neutral reflection-control surfaces/bright bands; preserve actual subject base color without requiring the bright surface to enter frame
Evidence-based object color or self-designed emphasis layer only, avoiding existing scientific color meanings

looks.lighting_note: A broad key light shapes form, local fill reveals interfaces as needed, and light control/reflection surfaces organize curvature. The subject must not become only a bright outline; preserve depth in backgrounds and black materials. No fixed light count, lighting ratio or passing exposure value.
looks.palette_note: Optional sRGB display reference for self-produced environments, not a fixed dark background for the whole film, mandatory scientific-material colors or unconverted scene-linear shader values.
